timing.scope: Complete task lifecycles, tools, queue waits and captures; model loading excluded. Sum of recorded active sessions excludes downtime between restarts. Missing interrupted-session telemetry makes full-cell timing unavailable. ITL is per-sequence token intervals, excluding prefill. Memory is leader-rank CUDA allocator peak, not total TP memory. Zero model batches denotes rejected requests; the observed rejection duration is not model inference latency and has no ITL or inference-memory measurement.
